text:
Marta: FYI - customer FinServe intake: wants an instruct variant (instruct-tuned) with 64k context, int4 quant for cost, deterministic outputs for compliance. Target: canary next week, p95 token-gen <= 250ms if possible. I'll upload their prompt set shortly.
Simon: int4 + 64k is going to be tricky. KV cache quantization + attention kernels may need changes. We should baseline against 8-bit first. Do we have domain prompts? :eyes:
Devin: I can run the quant sweep + qbench. Need customer prompt set and a short eval harness for hallucination/accuracy. Is this Hosted or Dedicated?
Alexa: Dedicated. Sales flagged P1 (enterprise). I'll mark it on the intake board and request SLA doc from CS. Add regression monitoring to rollout plan.
Josh: Proposed quick checklist: 1) model artifact upload 2) tokenizer/longctx build 3) quant sweeps (int8,int4) 4) 1k eval + hallucination tests 5) canary config + fallback to 8-bit. I'll open tickets.
Marta: @Devin I'll DM the domain prompts and a redacted sample dataset. @Simon can you estimate kernel work effort for int4 KV?
Simon: Rough estimate: 2-3 days for kernel changes & perf tuning on A100/H100, plus 1 day for CI perf runs. For rollout we should stage 32k fast-path first, then extend to 64k once kernels are validated.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot created issue ENG-ML-2345: "FinServe instruct-64k-int4 onboarding" :white_check_mark:
Devin: I'll start with a quick qbench command locally to validate perf: `./tools/qbench --model /mnt/models/finserve-instruct --ctx 65536 --quant int4 --output /tmp/qres.json`
Marta: And quality check command: `evals/run.py --suite hallucination,qa,consistency --baseline ref/33b-8bit --cand /tmp/qres.json` — flag any rouge/EM drops > 3 pts as regression.
Alexa: I'll own canary scheduling and alerts. Criterion: if hallucination rate increases > 2% or rouge drop > 3, auto-fallback.
Josh: Timeline proposal: quant sweep + baseline bench by Wed, candidate build + internal eval by Thu, canary spec ready Fri. Customer-ready next week if all green. Thoughts?
Simon: Sounds good. If quant sweep shows >5% quality hit on instruct prompts, we should consider hybrid approach (int4 for KV + int8 for MLP) or fallback to 8-bit.
Devin: I'll log intermediate results to /artifacts/finserve/qbench/* and share a short summary doc with plots (ppl, latency, mem).
Marta: Great — I'll push the customer's SLA and prompt set here when I have it. Please tag this thread when you push tickets. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Josh: tagging ENG-SRE for perf infra once we hit kernel tests. @ENG-SRE :wave:
Marta: leaving this as the intake root — will update as artifacts land.
